title: La Cajeta de Celaya, MEXI STORIES
comment: cajeta-celaya (MEXI): pequeña fábrica de cajeta junto a la casa familiar en Celaya, Guanajuato. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ROGACIANO_LEON: Mexican man from Guanajuato, cajeta maker, 74 years old, small and thin, light-brown wrinkled skin, white hair combed to the side, a thin white mustache, a white long-sleeve shirt under a brown knitted vest, grey trousers, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.LETICIA_LEON: Mexican woman, 45 years old, light skin, short straight black bob haircut, red lipstick, a cream blazer over a black blouse, black trousers, gold earrings, holding a folder of papers.
chars.LIC_MENDOZA: Mexican businessman, 50 years old, medium build, light-brown skin, short grey hair, rectangular glasses, clean-shaven, a light-grey suit with a white shirt and a dark-blue tie, holding a black briefcase.

locs.LOC_FABRICACAJETA: Small family cajeta factory beside a house in Celaya, Guanajuato, in the afternoon: big copper cazos of bubbling caramel on gas burners, wooden paddles, rows of small round wooden boxes and glass jars, white tiled walls, an open door to a patio with a jacaranda tree and the family house, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no labels, no logos, no people.
